bodies.scope: Filled and resting order-status MessagePack payloads project their nested fields in fixed order with mode-dependent map or array containers; quantity fields are normalized strings, oid is unsigned integer and absent cloid is omitted. Valid option flags and serializer modes only. Outer dispatch and generic encoders are credited context; initial Rust float rendering, allocation failure, full post-block responses and target execution remain outside the claim.
